I saved Pree's note to the shared knowledge base as a fact about Marrow Agrisupply: the new inbound lane's site is Dock 23. The note is credited to Pree's #central-team message from 2026-10-14. There was no earlier entry for Marrow Agrisupply to conflict with, though the search was keyword-only, so it could have missed one worded differently.

I replied to Pree in a thread on their #central-team message: "Thanks Pree, noted: the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Dock 23." Nothing else was needed: no mail, no finance figures and no approvals.
